name: PT Barito Pacific Tbk
summary: PT Barito Pacific Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the petrochemical production business. It operates through Petrochemical and Refinery, Building and Hotel Management, Energy and Resources, Property, and Others segments. The company produces a palette of olefins, polyolefins, styrene monomer, and butadiene, including by-products. It also operates geothermal energy resources and wind power plant projects. In addition, the company engages in the development and construction of industrial and commercial properties; marine transportation; logistics; and glue production for particleboards.
